the IL-2/IL-2R beta pathway plays an important role in J chain upregulaton.
CH12.Lx cells produce IL-2 and respond to it in an autocrine manner, and this response is mediated by the IL-2 beta receptor.

CH12.Lx cells produce IL-2, which acts on the cells in an autocrine manner, and that the IL-2 response is mediated by the IL-2 beta chain, not the alpha chain, and that the response leads to increased J chain gene expression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of immunoglobulin J-chain expression in B lymphocytes.
the role of IL-2 in B cell activation.
the molecular mechanisms of B cell differentiation and activation and the role of the J chain in the regulation of immunoglobulin secretion.

the J chain gene expression in the B cell line is regulated by IL-2R.

the IL-2 beta chain is required for the autocrine IL-2 signaling that drives the expression of the immunogloblin J chain in the CH12.LX B cell line.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IL-2/IL-2R pathway is a critical regulator of B cell differentiation.
the J chain promoter is responsive to the IL-2 signal transduction pathway, but only after the IL-2 has been bound by the IL-2 alpha beta receptor complex.
